BL-1288 — rematch-with-push-first! treats EVERY failed push as genuine divergence, so an unreachable remote or missing credential destroys local-ahead commits - and it throws away the :error string that is the only thing able to tell the two apart
What it solves: ## Verified before minting
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a human tap. The judgment worth a look: what a NON-rejection push failure should do instead of resetting. This ticket specifies "keep the commits and surface the reason" - it deliberately does NOT specify a retry, because the existing periodic push-s…
BL-1288 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1288" (or "reject BL-1288 <reason>") to act.
